void-canvas.$description: Void Canvas — Primary page background; the base upon which all display type and floating shapes sit

absolute-black.$description: Absolute Black — Deepest surface, decorative fills, icon strokes — the floor beneath the void

charcoal-plate.$description: Charcoal Plate — Footer and inverted section backgrounds, slightly elevated off the base void

smoke-plate.$description: Smoke Plate — Secondary surface for content blocks and image treatments layered over the void

graphite-lift.$description: Graphite Lift — Subtle elevation surface and card background; the only visible shadow color

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Primary text, hairline borders, icon outlines — the dominant non-black color in the system

linen.$description: Linen — Inverted body sections, off-white text on dark cards, soft warm-white content surfaces

ash.$description: Ash — Muted secondary text, nav labels, subtle borders — the whispered voice between bone and graphite

pebble.$description: Pebble — Disabled borders, tertiary helper text, low-priority metadata

iron.$description: Iron — Link underlines, nav dividers, hairline separators on dark surfaces

arterial-red.$description: Arterial Red — Sole brand accent — card borders, cursor, hero dot, gradient terminator; the only saturated color and it is used like a heartbeat, not a coat of paint

crimson-pure.$description: Crimson Pure — Heading underline accent and decorative fill — a purer red for typographic emphasis only

kmr-waldenburg.$description: Primary display and UI typeface across nav, headings, body, buttons, and the full scale from 10px tracked nav labels to 160px hero display. The custom face is the system's signature — its bold caps at 64–160px carry negative tracking (-0.075em to -0.080em) that compresses the letters into architectural blocks. Substitute: Neue Haas Grotesk Display, or Inter at matching weights and tracking.

editorialnew.$description: Serif italic companion — appears as the 'crafting' / 'for the' connective words between display caps and as refined body/heading accents. The contrast of this soft serif whisper against the 700-weight caps is the system's typographic signature. Substitute: Editorial Old, Canela, or Playfair Display Italic.

dirtyline-36-daysoftype-2022.$description: Ornamental display face used for single-letter or short-word spectacle moments (the stylized 'a' in 'WE ARE'). Aggressive -0.100em tracking at 24px makes it a sculptural object rather than readable type. Substitute: Tobias, Rogue Serif, or any expressive display serif with calligraphic contrast.

system-ui.$description: Quiet body fallback and small icon labels — only used where Kmr Waldenburg's geometric personality would overpower micro-copy. Effectively the 'muted' voice in the type system.
